club.description: Gade Park takes its name from the River Gade and the green corridors around Cassiobury Park in Watford. Woodlands, open fields and the waterways connecting the town to the surrounding countryside form the basis of the club's local identity.

descriptions.de: Gade Park ist nach dem Fluss Gade und den grünen Korridoren rund um den Cassiobury Park in Watford benannt. Wälder, offene Wiesen und die Wasserläufe, die die Stadt mit dem umliegenden Land verbinden, bilden die Grundlage der lokalen Identität des Vereins.
descriptions.es: Gade Park toma su nombre del río Gade y de los corredores verdes que rodean Cassiobury Park, en Watford. Los bosques, las praderas abiertas y los cursos de agua que conectan la ciudad con el campo circundante forman la base de la identidad local del club.
descriptions.fr: Gade Park tire son nom de la rivière Gade et des corridors verts autour de Cassiobury Park, à Watford. Les bois, les prairies ouvertes et les cours d'eau reliant la ville à la campagne environnante constituent le fondement de l'identité locale du club.
descriptions.it: Gade Park prende il nome dal fiume Gade e dai corridoi verdi intorno a Cassiobury Park, a Watford. I boschi, i prati aperti e i corsi d'acqua che collegano la città alla campagna circostante costituiscono la base dell'identità locale del club.
descriptions.en: Gade Park takes its name from the River Gade and the green corridors around Cassiobury Park in Watford. Woodlands, open fields and the waterways connecting the town to the surrounding countryside form the basis of the club's local identity.
